name: Warp Shader Background
description: Full-screen WebGL fragment shader background that renders a flowing black and white cosine-warped pattern, animated continuously with adjustable speed and warp strength.
contents: Full-width WebGL canvas filling the container with a generative warped pattern
behavior: Shader animates continuously using elapsed time
Canvas resizes with the container on window resize
Pointer events are disabled so content above stays interactive
fixed: Output is monochrome, colors are defined inside the shader
Root defaults to full width and screen height. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-96.
